parameters.name: Stereo Separation
parameters.description: Adjusts the Mid/Side balance to control stereo width

hip_hop_applications.moody: 30-40% left for atmospheric pads and dark synths
hip_hop_applications.upbeat: 50-60% left for hi-hats and percussion elements
hip_hop_applications.melodic: 25-35% left for keys, strings, and harmonic elements
hip_hop_applications.electronic: 45-55% left for synth pads and atmospheric layers
hip_hop_applications.trap: 60-70% left for hi-hat rolls and percussion

parameters.mono_compatibility: Does not affect pure mono signals
parameters.notes: Left increases width, right narrows to mono

parameters.name: Phase Offset
parameters.description: Delays one channel relative to the other to create psychoacoustic width

hip_hop_applications.moody: 15-25ms for atmospheric vocal layers and background elements
hip_hop_applications.melodic: 20-40ms for vocal harmonies and stacked vocals
hip_hop_applications.electronic: 15-30ms for vocal chops and synth leads
hip_hop_applications.trap: 20-30ms for vocal ad-libs and background vocals

parameters.mono_compatibility: Creates phase cancellation in mono - always check
parameters.notes: Creates pan shift toward undelayed side - compensate with Pan control

parameters.name: Invert Phase
parameters.description: Flips the polarity of one channel

hip_hop_applications.moody: Rarely used - creates thin, hollow effects
hip_hop_applications.melodic: Creative effects on background layers only
hip_hop_applications.trap: Not commonly used in trap production

parameters.mono_compatibility: Severe cancellation in mono - use with extreme caution
parameters.notes: Always check mono compatibility when enabled

parameters.name: Pan
parameters.description: Adjusts final stereo positioning after processing
use_cases: Compensating for phase offset pan shift

hip_hop_applications.moody: Center for main elements, compensate offset shifts
hip_hop_applications.upbeat: Use to re-center after Haas effect
hip_hop_applications.electronic: Compensate for phase offset pan bias

parameters.notes: Essential for compensating phase offset pan shift

hip_hop_applications.upbeat: Compensate for any width-related level changes

common_mistakes: Using Phase Offset without mono checking
Not compensating pan after phase offset
Using separation on mono sources (no effect)
best_practices: Apply separation to existing stereo sources
Use phase offset on mono sources for width
Compensate pan shift with Pan control
Keep low frequencies narrow (mono or minimal width)
Use automation for dynamic width changes
